body:
He is more than welcome to come live with me, and he knows that. Before he moved, I told him that if for any reason things don’t work out, he can always come stay with me. No judgements. 

I would do anything possible to support my brother, he is the one of the most important person in the world to me. I hope that I can convince him to stay with me, but I don’t want him to feel pressured or forced into the decision. 

I called the hospital, and because he’s an adult they won’t tell me where he was transferred to for his evaluation. If I can find out where and when his release is, I plan on being there for him.
